0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-4, sixth in the East and 3 games back in the Atlantic, on a one-game winning streak) host the Celtics (8-2, second in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a three-game winning streak and 5-0 at home). Toronto is without Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Collin Murray-Boyles (illness) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Boston has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, after Toronto lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 115-101 loss in Boston on April 5, 2026.
